description: Core quality cases for Claude, GPT, Gemini, and generic text-assistant enhancement.

cases.prompt: make this email sound professional but not stiff: hey sam, the numbers are late again and i need them by friday or the launch slips

preserve: The email is addressed to Sam
The tone should be professional but not stiff
shouldInclude: Retain the direct deadline and consequence
Keep the output ready to send
mustAvoid: Changing Friday to a specific date

cases.prompt: Summarize the text below in no more than five bullets for an executive audience. Preserve all numbers, distinguish facts from recommendations, and do not add information that is not in the source.

shouldInclude: A clear placeholder or instruction for the source text
Light organization without changing the request
mustAvoid: Requiring XML when it adds no value

cases.prompt: translate this customer complaint into English, keep it frustrated but polite, and don't soften the refund request: Je suis déçu que ma commande soit encore en retard. Je souhaite un remboursement complet.

preserve: Keep a frustrated but polite tone
Do not soften the full-refund request

cases.prompt: extract name, company, email, and requested demo date from the text I provide. return valid JSON only. use null when something isn't stated.

shouldInclude: Provide a place for the source text

cases.prompt: explain compound interest to a 14 year old without equations

shouldInclude: Explain how growth builds on earlier growth
mustAvoid: Turning the request into a full lesson plan

cases.prompt: I may move to either Lisbon or Berlin next year. help me decide but don't assume my budget or visa situation.

preserve: Compare Lisbon and Berlin for a possible move next year
shouldInclude: Ask for or organize personal decision criteria
Separate stable considerations from time-sensitive facts
mustAvoid: Choosing a city for the user

cases.prompt: compare the current privacy features of Signal, WhatsApp, and Telegram for a nontechnical audience. cite reliable sources and say when the information was checked.

mustAvoid: Assuming one product is best for everyone

cases.prompt: interview me for a product manager job. ask one question at a time and wait for my answer. don't answer for me.

preserve: Ask one question at a time
Do not answer for the user
shouldInclude: Adapt later questions to the user's answers
mustAvoid: Inventing a company or seniority level

cases.prompt: write a hopeful sci-fi story under 300 words, second person, no dialogue, ending with the exact sentence: The signal was never meant for Earth.
give me 10 launch ideas for a solo indie app with zero ad budget. no paid ads and don't assume what the app does.

preserve: The product is a solo indie app
shouldInclude: Keep ideas adaptable to different app categories
Favor actions one person can execute
Mark where product-specific details are needed

cases.prompt: turn these meeting notes into decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines. don't invent owners or dates if they aren't in the notes.

preserve: Extract decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines
shouldInclude: Represent missing owners and deadlines explicitly
Keep extracted items grounded in the notes
mustAvoid: Adding decisions not present in the notes
